name: mod-builder
description: Plan, write, validate and review a Claude Mod (a plugin with a function-hooks module). Picks the smallest $ surface for the job and states the reach level before any code, generates the three files, runs claude plugin validate, refuses to widen the footprint without a reason, and writes a five-line threat model. A brainstorm mode ranks 10 to 20 ideas by benefit per unit of reach and checks each against every mod already on GitHub.
